trends.name: Eastern Mediterranean gas development buildout
trends.thesis: Operators and oilfield service firms are ramping up investment and service contracts to develop Eastern Mediterranean gas discoveries.

mentions.action: Advanced its Cronos ultra-deepwater gas field development off Cyprus by awarding a multi-year services contract
Won a multi-year contract for drilling, completions and automation services on Eni's Cyprus gas field

trends.name: LNG cooperation deals with Asian buyers
trends.thesis: Trading houses and Asian gas distributors are signing cooperation agreements to secure LNG supply and trading flexibility.

mentions.action: Signed an MOU with China's ENN to explore LNG cooperation
Signed an LNG supply agreement with India's BPCL as it diversifies its buyer base

Signed a long-term LNG supply deal with a unit of China's Suntien Green Energy
Sold a further 5% Browse LNG stake to Japan's Osaka Gas, taking its East Asian buyer farm-down to 10%
Raised China Gas's LNG offtake to 2.5 MMtpa under 20-year contracts starting 2030

trends.name: AI power demand sustaining gas/LNG investment
trends.thesis: Rising electricity demand from AI data centers is keeping energy companies committed to gas and LNG project investment despite higher financing costs.

mentions.action: CEO said higher borrowing costs have not slowed energy project investment amid AI-driven LNG demand

trends.name: Oil majors retreat from fuel retail forecourts
trends.thesis: BP and Shell are divesting fuel retail forecourt networks as independents consolidate the downstream retail business.

trends.name: US LNG export capacity expansion
trends.thesis: US LNG developers are completing and announcing new liquefaction trains to grow export capacity.

Caturus unit unveiled plans to nearly double Commonwealth LNG capacity to about 17.25 mtpa

trends.name: Biochar carbon removal supply scale-up
trends.thesis: Biochar producers and their carbon-market partners are rapidly expanding supply capacity and funding to meet growing demand for durable carbon removal.

mentions.action: Raised $1.5M in funding to scale biochar-as-a-service carbon removal in Sub-Saharan Africa
Expanded biochar carbon removal supply partnership with Carbonfuture to over 1.1 million tons through 2035
Expanded biochar carbon removal supply partnership with Exomad Green to over 1.1 million tons through 2035

trends.name: Corporate purchases of durable carbon removal
trends.thesis: Large corporations are signing megaton-scale offtake agreements with carbon removal developers, spanning engineered durable removal and nature-based projects, to lock in future supply and price certainty.

mentions.action: Signed a megaton-scale deal with Terradot for enhanced rock weathering carbon removal paired with methane avoidance in Brazil
As a Symbiosis Coalition member, helped structure standard offtake agreements covering over 40 million tons of nature-based carbon removal
Became a carbon credit buyer from Brazil's Mombak reforestation-based carbon removal fund
Signed a CORSIA-compliant carbon removal offtake deal with Climeworks spanning DAC, biochar and soil carbon
